00043 ThruUGenInternal::ThruUGenInternal(Thru_InputsWithTypesOnly) throw()
00044 : UGenInternal(NumInputs)
00045 {
00046  inputs[Input] = input;

00048 
00049 void ThruUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00050 {
00051  const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00052  float* const outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00053  float* const inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00054  
00055  memcpy(outputSamples, inputSamples, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00056 }

00058 Thru::Thru(Thru_InputsWithTypesOnly) throw()
00059 {
00060  initInternal(input.getNumChannels());

00062  {
